target_customer: Non programmers and business teams building internal apps from spreadsheets and data
problem: Building business apps required engineers; Glide lets anyone turn a Google Sheet, Excel file or prompt into a working app.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription tiers by users and usage
product_category: No-code app builder, internal business apps

founders.name: David Siegel
founders.background_notes: YC page: three technical founders, early employees at Xamarin acquired by Microsoft in 2016.

founders.name: Mark Probst
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder on the YC page.

founders.name: Jason Smith
founders.background_notes: Listed as co-founder on the YC page.

founders.name: Antonio Garcia Aprea
founders.background_notes: Named as co-founder (Antonio, no surname) in Glide's own Series A post; surname and Xamarin history from a secondary profile and unverified.

technical_complexity.rationale: Generating responsive apps from spreadsheet data with live sync is standard engineering, made easier by the founders' mobile framework background at Xamarin.

defensibility.rationale: Apps built on Glide are tied to its platform and community templates, but several no-code builders offered similar spreadsheet apps.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied Glide in the sources found; Glide stayed independent and expanded from mobile to web apps and AI.

market_need_then: Business users kept operational data in spreadsheets and lacked developers; Glide reports over 500,000 people started building and over 1 million apps and pages by April 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: Approachable: beautiful apps, accessible and fun

branding.brand_signature: Turns spreadsheets into apps; Glide Experts community
branding.community_and_virality: Forum with over 11,000 members, a Glide Experts program with a stated 6,000 plus experts, templates and Product Hunt launches; a 2024 pricing change caused community backlash

brand_strength.rationale: A real, friendly word with an active builder community and expert network, but no press about the brand itself and a generic name.

outcome_analysis: Glide launched on Product Hunt in February 2019, raised a 3.6M seed in November 2019 and a 20M Series A led by Benchmark in April 2022, with a team of 46 and a claim of over 100,000 businesses. Product led growth through templates, a community and an expert network, plus founders who knew developer tools, drove adoption, and it moved into AI app building. A 2024 pricing restructure upset some users, but no exit or shutdown was found.
notes: Seed amount varies: 3.6M per Glide, Dealroom and Everydev; 3M on Seedtable; one source says 4M. Total raised ranges from 23.75M (CB Insights) to 27M (Glide jobs page). Business Insider seed article could not be opened (host blocked).
